entries.title: Price work by department
entries.description: Assign each quote work item to Fabrication, Paint, Workshop, or Other so labour uses the appropriate rate. Job sheets now show the department and estimated hours for each item.

entries.title: Show complete quote breakdowns
entries.description: Generated quote PDFs now show the parts and labour included in each work item while keeping related rows together.

entries.title: Keep long quote tables clear
entries.description: Column headings now repeat on every page when a quote pricing table spans multiple pages.

entries.title: Simplify product information
entries.description: The Technical Details field has been removed from products and related screens.

entries.title: Improve assembly page spacing
entries.description: The assembly section heading now sits closer to its content for a cleaner layout.

entries.title: Keep the assistant composer visible
entries.description: The message composer now stays above the keyboard while you chat with the assistant.
